system.description: Make a Static Mental Challenge against a nine-Trait difficulty and expend one or more Blood Traits to animate a target's shadow into a loyal dark servitor sharing all of its parent's Traits and six Bruised Health Levels, able to invoke Shadow Play for a Mental Trait. It cannot move more than 50 feet from its parent, takes half damage from physical attacks but double from supernatural/fire/sunlight, and its death costs its parent a Willpower Trait. Maximum Shadow Twins per night equals your Morality Traits.
system.duration: 1 hour per Blood Trait spent, max until sunrise
